# M2 — JD in, keyword match (plan)

**Status:** not started  
**Job:** `resume new` scores the warehouse against a job and always ships a pick list. No LLM.

## What to build

```
JD (URL | file | paste)
  → fetch/clean (code)
  → keywords + must-haves
  → score every warehouse bullet
  → top-N plan + coverage 3/9
  → print plan (not a gate)
```

Weak match still continues. Coverage is a number on screen.

## New files (do not edit `warehouse.py`)

| File | Function |
|---|---|
| `app/analyzing/cleaner.py` | strip nav/boilerplate from JD text |
| `app/analyzing/keywords.py` | aliases (`JS`=`JavaScript`), must-have vs nice-to-have |
| `app/analyzing/analyzer.py` | facade → `JobAnalysis` |
| `app/planning/scorer.py` | keyword overlap score per bullet/item |
| `app/planning/planner.py` | top-N within a budget (e.g. 3 jobs, 3 projects, 4 bullets each) |
| `app/fetching/generic.py` | URL → text |
| `app/fetching/router.py` | URL vs file vs paste |
| `app/models.py` | add `JobPosting`, `JobAnalysis`, `ResumePlan` only |

CLI: add `resume new` in `app/cli.py` (new command, not new logic).

## Libraries

| Lib | Use |
|---|---|
| **httpx** | GET the JD URL (browser User-Agent) |
| **beautifulsoup4** | strip `script` / `style` / `nav` / footer |
| **Typer + Rich** | already in M1 — prompts, color, `3/9` |
| stdlib `re` | keywords + aliases |

Do **not** add sentence-transformers, OpenAI, or Ollama here.

## How to code it

1. **Input:** `resume new <url>`, `resume new ./jd.txt`, or `resume new -` and paste.
2. **Clean:** visible text only. No Playwright in M2 (JS-only pages = thin text; user can paste).
3. **Keywords:** scan JD against profile `vocabulary` + a small alias map. Lines under “requirements” → `must_have`; “nice to have” → bonus. `missing` = must-haves with no warehouse hit.
4. **Score:** count overlapping terms on each bullet (and its item tech). Pure Python.
5. **Plan:** pick highest scores until the section budget is full. Record a one-line reason (`matches: pandas, SQL`).
6. **Print:** selected IDs, reasons, `must-haves 3/9`. Never `raise` because coverage is low.

## Done when

A DS URL against a mixed SWE+DS warehouse ranks DS bullets first, without loading Ollama.
